t: You're looking at the Danish Church, a Lutheran church in Camden. It was designed by Ambrose Poynter, a British architect who lived from 1796 to 1886. Poynter was one of the founding members of the Institute of British Architects in 1834, so he was part of the group that helped create the architectural profession as it exists today. The church is one of his designs, and it's a quiet corner of Lutheran worship in this part of north London.
